comparison.objective: Post a packet completely through a sprung drop-box flap.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasp-position planning, flap actuation through contact, packet insertion, release, and gravity-assisted drop.
comparison.success_condition: Packet wholly inside and at rest, with the flap closed within 5 mm for one second; no partial credit or explicit packet-damage threshold.
comparison.reason: This tests single-object insertion past an obstructing flap. It does not test selective size separation, multiple free bodies, bridging, or retention of workpieces.
